_comment: Tauri commands registered in apps/tauri/src-tauri/src/application.rs's generate_handler![...] with no invoke() caller anywhere in src/ today (architecture-hardening.md F24 / L1-2 / L2-4 gate 1). Checked by scripts/check-command-reachability.mjs. Remove an entry the moment it gets a caller (or gets deleted from Rust) — a lingering entry either way is a stale allowlist and fails the gate.
app_menu_dispatch_for_test: Debug-build-only: tests/macos-quit-flush.mjs drives the Quit menu item's handler through the dev MCP bridge (execute_js), not from src/. A no-op in release builds.
puppet_key: Called by crates/futo-puppet (just puppet type/press on desktop) over the debug mcp bridge as window.__TAURI__.core.invoke — deliberately no invoke() in src/, the app never types into itself.
puppet_pointer: Called by crates/futo-puppet (just puppet click/drag) over the debug mcp bridge as window.__TAURI__.core.invoke — deliberately no invoke() in src/, the app never clicks itself.
puppet_screenshot: Called by crates/futo-puppet (just puppet screenshot on Linux, where the mcp bridge has no native capture) over the debug mcp bridge as window.__TAURI__.core.invoke — deliberately no invoke() in src/, the app never photographs itself.
